title: Gram cache after a fixed FIR effect

definition.title: Gram cache after a fixed FIR effect
definition.source_excerpt: Six synchronized stems were filtered once by the same fixed 65-tap FIR. The candidate cached the 6×6 Gram matrix of those filtered stems. For 180 random gain vectors, g^T G g matched directly mixed-and-measured output to maximum relative error 9.66e-16. The cache is tiny (288 bytes) but construction cost matters: 7.81 ms to build, then 0.087 ms for all cached queries, versus 10.78 ms direct. This is an amortized analysis optimization, not a replacement for producing output samples.
